name: AttributeComponentServerFacet_RequestSpendAttributePoints
summary: The client's attribute-point spend: two u64 BE head fields, then a prefix-varint-counted vector of attribute indices and a prefix-varint-counted vector of points. 26-byte body, C2S. One live 26-byte record matches the static writer/reader layout field for field.
purpose: The client applies a pending attribute allocation: the two head u64 are the character identity pair, the index vector names which CharacterAttributeType slots and the points vector the amount spent on each. The Attribute family has zero reply messages, so the server only changes replicated state.

created_when: the player confirms (Asignar) a staged attribute allocation in the character panel
lifecycle.if_absent: the spend is never sent and the attribute stays at its old value

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint 9e 17, i.e. type_dec 1502. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: local_facet_id
fields.note: First u64 of the shared message head, and the sending facet's own local id - identity, not request data. The send builder fills msg+0x08 from FUN_1416c1c40(facet) = *[*[facet+8]+8] + [GDE+0x10]: [GDE+0x10] is the id handed out by the global id dispenser FUN_14144a9f0 at ClientGDE attach (writer FUN_141464890 <- FUN_14167c760), and *[*[facet+8]+8] is a base read off the object the GDE's server-GDE reference resolves to (FUN_1417db510). That same value is the key the facet registers itself under in the Context's facet map (FUN_14167c560: key FUN_1416c1c40(facet), value the facet object, slot array at Context+0x1b0) and the key the RMI dispatcher looks up, so it is the local id the server must address. The client names it itself: log field facetId, 'Failed to unregister the facet.', and on a duplicate collidingLocalId + collidingFacetName with 'We got a collision on facets IDs, RMIs may fail to be delivered to this facet.'; the dispatch failure line calls it targetLocalId. Measured 0xe05592a1d48c417 on the 2026-10-27 live record, byte-identical to the builder's *param_2.

fields.name: local_actor_id_word0
fields.note: Second u64 of the shared message head, and the first 8 bytes of the client's own actor id - identity, not request data. Writer FUN_1414dbca0 copies the message object's +0x10 through a stack local and writes it big-endian (htonl64 FUN_1461668a0) through the stream raw-write slot +0x40. The send builder fills +0x10 from FUN_1416be9f0, which dereferences the weak handle at the GDE's +0x60 (FUN_14165c230) and reads [session+0x88]. Measured 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in all 14 committed bodies of the six head-prefixed messages across five sessions; in the same records its little-endian bytes 1a954abc4b3185bf are the first 8 of the record's 16-byte actor id, the local player's actor id handed over by ClientAddEntryMsg (0xa4).

fields.name: attribute_indices
fields.note: Prefix-varint count, then count x u32 BE. Measured [2] (Strength) on the live record. Each index is a CharacterAttributeType in 0..4; the client asserts an index above 4 (FUN_141788630) and the runtime cap is 4. meanings.md 'The first field layout: 0x5de'.

fields.name: points
fields.note: Prefix-varint count, then count x u32 BE. Measured [1] on the live record. Each value is a points amount the client asserts <= 700 (FUN_14279bb40); the runtime cap is 700. meanings.md 'The first field layout: 0x5de'.

evidence.ref: Head provenance, recovered 2026-11-01: the shared writer FUN_1414dbca0 stores msg+0x08 (straight) then msg+0x10 (through a stack local) with FUN_140877280 = htonl64 FUN_1461668a0 + stream raw-write slot +0x40; the reader FUN_14150e670 mirrors it. This wire's builder FUN_142760cf0 fills +0x08 with FUN_1416c1c40(...) and +0x10 with *FUN_1416be9f0(...) = [session+0x88]
research/atlas/meanings.md 'The first field layout: 0x5de, decoded statically' - writer FUN_1427484d0 / reader FUN_142750870 agree field for field
